intro: The Bahamas is a chain of about 700 islands where Columbus first landed in the Americas in 1492.

chapters.title: The Lucayans
text: The Lucayan people, a Taíno group, lived here. Columbus landed on an island he called San Salvador in October 1492. Within a few decades the Lucayans were enslaved and taken away by the Spanish.

chapters.title: Pirates and British rule
text: English settlers arrived in the 1640s. Nassau became a base for pirates like Blackbeard until British governor Woodes Rogers drove them out in 1718. Loyalists fleeing the American Revolution brought enslaved Africans.

highlight.title: Pirate republic
highlight.text: Nassau was a pirate stronghold in the early 1700s.

chapters.title: Independence
text: The Bahamas became independent in 1973. Hurricane Dorian devastated the Abaco and Grand Bahama islands in 2019.

keyTerms.meaning: The original people of the Bahamas.
